literature_pmid_33251515:abstract:0.excerpt: Bed rest results in upper and lower leg muscle atrophy in a linear pattern, and an 11-day rehabilitation program was safe and effective in initiating a rapid trajectory of muscle recovery.

literature_pmid_33251515:abstract:1.excerpt: Across all muscles except the rectus femoris (no change), there was a linear decline during bed rest

literature_pmid_33251515:abstract:2.excerpt: with the highest atrophic rate occurring in the soleus (-0.33%/d)

literature_pmid_33251515:abstract:3.excerpt: the quadriceps (-3.74 cm 2 ; 95% CI, -7.36 to -0.12; p = 0.04)

literature_pmid_33251515:abstract:5.excerpt: medial gastrocnemius (-0.62 cm 2 ; 95% CI, -1.10 to -0.14; p = 0.01)

literature_pmid_33251515:abstract:7.excerpt: an 11-day rehabilitation program was safe and effective in initiating a rapid trajectory of muscle recovery

literature_pmid_33251515:abstract:8.excerpt: The 11-day post-bed rest rehabilitation program consisted of low intensity exercise and progressed to increased aerobic exercise duration, plyometric exercises, and higher intensity resistance exercise.

literature_pmid_38328821:abstract:0.excerpt: In summary, the periodic testing likely provided a partial exercise countermeasure for the quadriceps in the bedrest group, which is a novel finding given the extremely low exercise dose. The SPRINT exercise program appears to be viable for the quadriceps; however, refinement is needed to completely protect triceps surae myocellular and whole muscle health for astronauts on long-duration spaceflights.

literature_pmid_38328821:abstract:1.excerpt: In BRE, MHC I (vastus lateralis and soleus) and IIa (vastus lateralis) contractile performance was maintained ( P  > 0.05) or increased

literature_pmid_38328821:abstract:2.excerpt: Exercise offsets 100% of quadriceps and approximately two-thirds of soleus whole muscle mass loss.

literature_pmid_38328821:abstract:3.excerpt: Testosterone (BRE + T) did not provide any benefit over exercise alone for either muscle and for some myocellular parameters appeared detrimental.

literature_pmid_38328821:abstract:4.excerpt: In BR, surprisingly, the typical bedrest-induced decrements in vastus lateralis myofiber size and power were either blunted (myosin heavy chain, MHC I) or eliminated (MHC IIa), along with no change ( P  > 0.05) in %MHC distribution and blunted quadriceps atrophy.
